reason: This page contains durable, high-impact deletion semantics that should be available in the wiki: removing an allowlisted key prevents its future use across every instance of the selected entity type and makes existing values inaccessible. It also defines the exact operation path, required entity and key inputs, supported entity scope, and success response, so treating it as navigation-only would omit material integration behavior.

grounding_quotes.text: > Removes a custom field key from the allowlist for a specific entity type, preventing future use of that key across all instances of the entity. Existing values for this key on entity instances will no longer be accessible once the key is removed.
grounding_quotes.supports: Removing a key has a durable, destructive consequence: it blocks future use across the entity type and makes existing values inaccessible.
The documented API operation targets the /v1/customFields/removeKey path.
The request requires both an entity and a key.
